previously known as '''Wooje'''. |checkboxIsSub=No |checkbox-res=No }} == Biography == == Trivia == * His mother recommended him the nickname "Zeus", because the transcription of his nickname is similar to his name. * His favourite champions are {{ci|Kennen}} and {{ci|Jayce}}. * His role model is [[Nuguri]]. * Is a fan of [[Zika]]'s IGN because they both use the latin alphabet 'Z' as the first letter of their name. * Had 3 Challenger accounts at the age of 15. * In the start of his career, considered [[Kuri]] his older brother. * Is the only toplaner to be in worlds finals 3 times. * Is the first toplaner to win a back-to-back world championship. * Famously hit himself on the head while lifting the Summoner's Cup after winning [[2024 Season World Championship|Worlds 2024]]. * Reached 1000 kills in the LCK on April 4th, 2025. ** The 31st player and 5th toplaner to reach 1000 kills in the LCK. ** His 1000th kill was on [[KT Rolster]]'s toplaner [[PerfecT (Lee Seung-min)|PerfecT]] in the [[LCK/2025 Season/Rounds 1-2|LCK 2025 Rounds 1-2]] with {{ci|Jax}}. * Reached 100 international wins during [[Worlds 2025 Main Event|Worlds 2025]] on October 22, 2025 against [[CTBC Flying Oyster]] in Round 4 of Swiss Stage, becoming the 8th player to achieve this milestone after [[Faker]], [[xiaohu]], [[Caps]], [[Keria]], [[Oner]]/[[Gumayusi]], and [[Canyon]]. * He has won every possible trophy at Tier 1 level (Worlds, MSI, First Stand, LCK, LCK Cup, EWC and Asian Games). {{PlayerStatsTrivia}} === Individual Awards === * Worlds Finals MVP x1 (2023) * MSI Finals MVP x1 (2026) * LCK Top-Laner of the Year x3 (2022, 2023, 2024) * LCK Cup Finals MVP x1 (2025) * LCK 1st All-Pro Team x3 (Spring 2022, Summer 2022, Spring 2023) * LCK 2nd All-Pro Team x1
